name: Browser
summary: A full Chromium browser workspace for Girru.
description: A Chromium browser workspace that opens from the Girru application menu. On supported desktop platforms, installation requires a reviewed full native runtime archive. Existing browser profiles, cookies, passwords and keychains are never imported automatically. Agent automation remains separately enabled and requires its existing access grants. Full workspace availability depends on the installed desktop host and published platform runtime; an automation-only installation does not provide the workspace.
permissions: Downloads and runs a full Chromium workspace when a reviewed desktop runtime is available
Agent automation remains separately enabled and keeps its existing access grants
Agent browser tools keep their existing separate grants
Keeps screenshots and downloads in the local data folder
Does not import existing browser profiles, cookies or passwords
